long_biography.plain_text:
Known publicly as Ali, Alexandra DeGray entered the American Saddlebred world as a child after seeing a park-trot horse work at her aunt’s farm. She began showing with Ruth Gimpel Stables in 1996 and expanded across saddle-seat, western, hunt-seat and driving classes with Saddlebreds, Standardbreds and Hackney ponies.

At the 2021 World’s Championship Horse Show, DeGray won five combined World’s Champion and World’s Champion of Champions titles. She later received the C.J. ‘June’ Cronan Trophy as a USEF Equestrian of Honor. She has remained active in competition and serves on the American Saddlebred Horse and Breeders Association board. Beyond the show ring, DeGray is vice president, treasurer and secretary of an animal-rescue foundation.
